title: Node.js
label: Node.js
desc: Server-side JavaScript runtime with built-in modules for files, HTTP, streams and processes.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Confirm the runtime, start a project and run a file.

snippets.code:
# Check which Node and npm answer on this machine
node --version
npm --version

# Create a folder with a package.json inside
mkdir orders-api
cd orders-api
npm init --yes

# Run a file once, then restart it on every save
node main.js
node --watch main.js

sections.title: Modules
sections.description: Share code between files with ESM or the older CommonJS loader.

sections.title: package.json
sections.description: The manifest that names the project, its entry point and its dependencies.

snippets.code:
# Add a runtime dependency: manifest and lockfile change together
npm install zod

# Add a tool that only development needs
npm install --save-dev eslint

# Install exactly what the lockfile pins, as CI should
npm ci

# List packages with newer versions, without touching anything
npm outdated

sections.title: npm Scripts
sections.description: Name the commands the project uses so nobody memorises flags.

snippets.code:
# Run one named script
npm run dev

# Pass extra arguments through: the double dash is required
npm run test -- --test-name-pattern "creates an order"

# List the scripts this package defines
npm run

sections.title: Configuration
sections.description: Load environment files and validate values at boot.

snippets.code:
# Node reads the file before the entry point runs (Node 20.6+)
node --env-file=.env src/server.js

# Optional override layer, ignored when the file is absent (Node 22.9+)
node --env-file=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local src/server.js

# .env stays out of git; values below are examples
DATABASE_URL=postgres://app:secret@127.0.0.1:5432/orders
SESSION_SECRET=6f1c2a9d4b7e8f30
PORT=3000
LOG_LEVEL=debug

sections.title: Testing
sections.description: Write and run unit tests with the built-in node:test runner.

snippets.code:
# Run every test file the runner discovers
node --test

# Run one file with the readable reporter
node --test --test-reporter=spec test/pricing.test.js

# Report line coverage (Node 22, still experimental)
node --test --experimental-test-coverage

sections.title: Debugging
sections.description: Inspect a running process, read warnings and profile a slow run.

snippets.code:
# Open the inspector and pause before the first statement
node --inspect-brk src/server.js

# Print the stack behind every process warning
node --trace-warnings src/server.js

# Write a CPU profile that loads in Chrome DevTools
node --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir=profiles src/batch.js

sections.title: Performance
sections.description: Measure time, memory and CPU work before optimising anything.

sections.title: Common Errors
sections.description: Three failures behind most broken first runs, and the way out.

snippets.code:
# Port already taken
Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use 127.0.0.1:3000

# ESM import without the file extension
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module '/srv/app/src/format'

# Top-level await inside a CommonJS file
SyntaxError: await is only valid in async functions and the top level bodies of modules

# Find whoever holds port 3000 and stop it
lsof -i :3000
kill 4817

# Or pick another port for this run
PORT=3001 node src/server.js
